A.name: Jedaiah
A.line: priest (1CH 9:10, NEH 7:39, NEH 12:6), of the house of Jeshua (EZR 2:36)
family: priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

B.name: Jedaiah
family: son-of joiarib-3 (Joiarib, priest, father of Jedaiah (NEH 11:10))
priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)

why: The Hebrew lists Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin as separate priests, fitting A’s stated priestly listing without identifying Jedaiah as Joiarib’s son. This only weakly favors A: no father or other unique identifier is given, and B is also a priest.
